### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/objectql`, touching **10** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/core/src/utils/required-emptiness.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via os migrate blank-single-values (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/blank-single-values.ts))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/core/src/utils/required-emptiness.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `ObjectQL (symbol, 79 pages)`
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **70** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 55dca466701606e691c1c96d14ba68dd32b6b06e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `aa46f8ffe1b34c419f525a6d9b1857ea0db4b763` — the merge of head `b702c0f1cee285eed74ff9e93e23a53c3babe785` into base `55dca466701606e691c1c96d14ba68dd32b6b06e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin aa46f8ffe1b34c419f525a6d9b1857ea0db4b763 && git checkout aa46f8ffe1b34c419f525a6d9b1857ea0db4b763
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 55dca466701606e691c1c96d14ba68dd32b6b06e b702c0f1cee285eed74ff9e93e23a53c3babe785 && git checkout -B drift-repro 55dca466701606e691c1c96d14ba68dd32b6b06e && git merge --no-ff b702c0f1cee285eed74ff9e93e23a53c3babe785

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 55dca466701606e691c1c96d14ba68dd32b6b06e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 55dca466701606e691c1c96d14ba68dd32b6b06e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `8e4ba0244a1d4133eba059bf2ace13c8738e2dc8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/core/src/utils/blank-storage-form.ts, packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, packages/core/src/utils/required-emptiness.ts, .changeset/29343-multi-value-blank-null.md + packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/blank-single-values.ts

This review is owed for the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line alone, under claim amendment 6591192037. It is a declaration face: no `packages/spec/**` path and no governed path is in the diff. The seat reviewed it at its own tier.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The rule.** `blankAsNullColumns` sends every optional, non-lifecycle column whose `expandEmptyOperator` arm is `multi_value` to the new `'emptyList'` reach, unique or not. That is ruling A (6591577985) word for word.
  - `blankStorageForm(v, 'emptyList')` maps `[]` and exactly `''` to `null`, and keeps whitespace and every non-empty list.
  - The `required` gate sits before the new arm, so `[]` on a required column still reaches `isEmptyForRequired` and is refused. The #9447 second half stands, as ruled.
- **The door.** `normalizeBlankTypedRow` now admits an empty array as a candidate blank. It nulls the value only where `blankStorageForm` says `null`, so `[]` on a column outside the reach (a JSON field, a required list) passes through untouched.
- **The seed replay** (`seed-loader.ts` `isNoOpReplay`) already compares `blankStorageForm(value, reach)` with no string gate. A seed `[]` compares as `null`, which matches the changeset's "rewritten to `null` once on the next replay".
- **`os migrate blank-single-values`** takes only `reach === 'empty'`, so the new arm does not widen it. The changeset's "does not touch these columns" holds.
- **Pins and prose moved to `null`**, as spec record 6595089655 named them (via 6595097212):
  - the objectql cascade probe, now asserting the key is present and `null`;
  - the runtime real-driver and service-automation pins;
  - `required-emptiness.ts`, the two `engine.ts` docblocks and the six hand-written docs pages.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: yes (widening)`: a second cleared write that used to be refused `409` now lands, and no write that used to land is refused. `Metadata-protocol: none`: an author can write nothing new. `@objectstack/core` patch and `@objectstack/objectql` patch. Under the changeset rule, a non-protocol change ships `patch`. `BlankAsNullReach` gains a union member, which the changeset's Export bullet names.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Read change, disclosed:** an optional multi-value field cleared from now on reads back `null`, not `[]`, and now matches `$null: true`. The changeset says so, and it is what the ruling chose. The ruling cited the seat's census of 0 field-level `unique` multi-value declarations in 140 `*.object.ts`, but the read change reaches every optional multi-value column, not only unique ones.
- **Stored `'[]'` / `'""'` rows** are #29653's data step and are left alone here, as ordered.

### ④ Design judgment

**Should-fix (prose, outside the claimed surface):** the docblock of `blankSingleValueColumns` in `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/blank-single-values.ts` (L106-118) is now wrong twice.
- It says "That map holds three arms"; it now holds four.
- It lists "`multiple: true` columns (the `multi_value` row)" as out "by the map's own rule". The map now INCLUDES them, as `'emptyList'`. They are out because this run takes only `reach === 'empty'`.

The seat amends the claim to add that docblock, and the dev fixes it in a patch round. There is no must-fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-4rru8k`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbYyp6wSRcywGFK2L4A`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `60dc73ff71c5f729ca9ced300ae37340249de3a9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/core/src/utils/blank-storage-form.ts, packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts + packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-activity.object.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-changed-fields.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-field-redaction.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/activity-changed-fields.integration.test.ts

**VERDICT: FAIL**

This record **supersedes** this reviewer's PASS records 6597445147 and 6597824563 on this PR. CI on this head (`Test Core (4/8)`, job 125777038850) shows a consumer that the first review did not read. The PR is draft with no auto-merge armed, so there is nothing to disarm.

### ① Derived judgments

- **M1 (must-fix): the `'emptyList'` arm erases the ADR-0139 E6 "stamped, empty" state of `sys_activity.changed_fields`.**
  - `changed_fields` is an optional `tags` column (`sys-activity.object.ts`, `required: false`, `readonly: true`). Its own description says: "empty for every other row … NULL means the row is not stamped yet".
  - The writer stamps `[]` on every non-update activity: `planActivityStamp` returns `{ changed_fields: [], … }` (`activity-changed-fields.ts`), which `audit-writers.ts` writes on insert.
  - The read rule keeps a row only when `changed_fields` is not null. An unstamped row "is withheld" from every non-system reader (`activity-field-redaction.ts`, ADR-0139 D4).
  - With this PR, the door stores that `[]` as `null`. Every create, delete and note activity written from now on therefore reads as unstamped, and is withheld from every non-system reader.
  - The backfill `os migrate activity-changed-fields` reads only NULL rows. It would re-plan those rows forever: CI `activity-changed-fields.integration.test.ts` cases 2–4 expect `changed_fields: []` and receive `null`.
- Ruling A (6591577985) reads "a cleared optional multi-value field … is stored as `null`". For `changed_fields`, `[]` is not a clear: it is a platform-written value that means "judged, nothing changed". So the ruling's reach as built collides with a second, already-ruled meaning of NULL.

### ② Semver level

Not reached: the head fails.

### ③ Boundary flags

- This is an access-visibility regression: activity rows that non-system readers see today would be withheld. It is not a security leak; it fails closed.
- Other optional multi-value columns where `[]` and NULL mean different things have not been censused. The decision analysis should count them.

### ④ Design judgment

This needs a ruling, not a dev fix, because each route changes either ruling A's reach or ADR-0139 E6. The routes the seat sees:
- **(a)** the `'emptyList'` arm skips `readonly: true` columns: platform-stamped, never cleared by a writer;
- **(b)** `sys_activity` moves its "unstamped" marker off NULL (an ADR-0139 amendment, a migration);
- **(c)** narrow ruling A back to unique-covered columns.

The seat puts this to the maintainer through a decision thread and holds the PR at this head. ⛔ No push until the ruling is recorded on #29343.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-4rru8k`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbYyp6wSRcywGFK2L4A`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `b702c0f1cee285eed74ff9e93e23a53c3babe785`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/core/src/utils/blank-storage-form.ts, packages/core/src/utils/blank-storage-form.test.ts, .changeset/29343-multi-value-blank-null.md (delta `60dc73ff..b702c0f1`: merge of `origin/main` `55dca466` as `b784ff6a`, then `b702c0f1`, +28/−1) + packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-field-redaction.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-changed-fields.ts

**VERDICT: PASS**

This is a delta review by the same at-tier reviewer as FAIL record 6597870397, answering its M1 under ruling record 6598733139 (round 2, letter A, maintainer 08:17Z). It **supersedes** that FAIL for this PR.

### ① Derived judgments

- **M1 resolved, as ruled.** `BlankAsNullFieldDef` gains `readonly?: boolean`. In `blankAsNullColumns`, the `multi_value` branch now sets `'emptyList'` only when `def.readonly !== true`, and `continue`s either way. A readonly multi-value column therefore gets no reach. `blankStorageForm(v, undefined)` returns the value as written, so `sys_activity.changed_fields` keeps the `[]` its writer stamps.
- **The other arms are unchanged.** The `'blank'` and `'empty'` arms are untouched, as the ruling bounds them. The unit pin's control `stage_ro` (a readonly `select`) still maps to `'empty'`, and the plain `tags` control still maps to `'emptyList'`.
- **The pin is exact:** `cols.has('changed_fields')` is false, and `blankStorageForm` returns the same array object.
- **Prose.** The docblock sentence and the changeset's **Readonly columns** bullet say what the code does and cite the record. The changeset's other sentences are unchanged and still hold.
- **The witnesses CI named are green on this head:** the `Test Core` shards, which carry cli `activity-changed-fields.integration` and plugin-audit `activity-changed-fields-backfill.integration`.
- **The merge `b784ff6a`** brings `origin/main` forward. It touches no file in this review's scope beyond main's own state.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/objectql` patch. `BlankAsNullFieldDef` gains an optional member: an additive type change on an existing export.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The census behind the ruling (record 6598733139): 15 multi-value columns across both repos, of which `sys_activity.changed_fields` is the only readonly optional one. The access-visibility regression of M1 is closed.
- #29653 (the stored-row data step) has a scope note on its card: exclude readonly columns.

### ④ Design judgment

This head follows ruling A with the round-2 carve-out exactly, and there is no must-fix. The optional prose-only spec card (a readonly clause in the `multiple` describe) is non-blocking and outside this PR.

Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbYyp6wSRcywGFK2L4A`

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：可选的多值字段（multiselect、tags、checkboxes，或 `multiple: true` 的 select / lookup / user / file / image）被清空为 `[]` 或 `''` 时，写入口改存 `null`。唯一键覆盖与否都一样。
  - 例外：`readonly: true` 列（平台盖章，如 `sys_activity.changed_fields`）照原样存 `[]`。
- 为什么改：唯一的多值列上第二条清空记录会被 409 拒绝。按裁决 A（6591577985），以及第二轮 A（6598733139，readonly 例外）执行。
- 风险与回滚：读变化——此后清空的可选多值字段读回 `null` 而非 `[]`，同时命中 `$null: true` 与 `$empty: true`；`required` 语义不变；已存的 `'[]'` 不迁移（#29653 负责，已注明排除 readonly）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/utils/blank-storage-form.ts` 的 `blankAsNullColumns` 里 `multi_value` 分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/utils/blank-storage-form.test.ts`，预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：这是 `Clause-②: yes (widening)`，席位按档复核了四轮。
  - PASS 6597445147 → delta PASS 6597824563 → FAIL 6597870397（CI 揭出 ADR-0139 E6 冲突）→ 裁决后 delta PASS 6599243504。
  - 本 head 已无 must-fix。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · `domain:server#3` · head `b702c0f1cee285eed74ff9e93e23a53c3babe785` · 2026-11-03T09:13Z · seat review of record at `TIER_DEFAULT` (declaration face: the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line). Not governed: `check-governed-merges --pr 29837` reports NOT governed, 680 lines. The review of record on this head is delta PASS 6599243504, which supersedes FAIL 6597870397.

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main`, `Fixes #29343`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (the body and the changeset agree; `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/objectql` patch). 22 files, +585/−95, inside the claim and its amendment. `mergeable_state` is clean. The seat read the diff at each round; the round-2 hunk sits inside the `multi_value` branch and leaves the `'blank'` and `'empty'` arms untouched.
2. **Premise measured:** red first, 12/15 at `97c2982c`. Ruling A (6591577985) and round-2 A (6598733139) are recorded on the card. The dev re-ran the census at objectstack `55dca466` and hotcrm `d4ffe99`: `sys_activity.changed_fields` is the only readonly optional multi-value column.
3. **Gates on this head:** check-runs pinned to `b702c0f1`: 69 total, 58 success, 10 skipped, 0 failed, 1 in progress (`Check Changeset`, rerun after the seat's body refresh; checked green before arming), including every `Test Core` shard, which carries the two CI witnesses of the FAIL record. Dev on this head:
   - cli 4/4 and 6/6; plugin-audit backfill 5/5; REST 34/34; core 2937/2937; objectql 10777/10777;
   - ablation reds exactly the CI cases;
   - 101 derived gates, 101 run, all exit 0.
4. **Prose checked against the diff:** each changeset sentence holds against the diff:
   - "**Readonly columns.** … a `[]` written there keeps `[]`": the `def.readonly !== true` guard and its pin.
   - "**Unchanged.** … A `required` multi-value field given `[]` or `''` is refused": the `required` continue before the arm.
   - "`os migrate blank-single-values` does not touch these columns": its `reach === 'empty'` filter.
5. **Out of scope:** #29653 (stored `'[]'` / `'""'`) is scoped by note 6598764965 to exclude readonly columns. The optional prose-only spec card (a readonly clause in the `multiple` describe) is left to the spec lane. `Skills-docs:` not owed (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
6. **Landing:** not governed, under 3000 lines, and contract review PASS on this head ⇒ the seat lands it (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`). At MERGED: landing record on #29343 (closed by `Fixes`), `pm:dispatched` removed, card thread stood down.
